scope: Reviewed correspondence of appendix displays and prose derivations to Lean statements. A mapping is not an automatic proof of equivalence between LaTeX and Lean. Model specifications remain assumptions; approximation formulas refer to their stated linearisation, not exact finite-sample covariance.
